scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
We are in urgency! The Barricade has been destroyed!
We can repair the Barricade with ^3131FF50 Stones, 3 Sinew of Bear, 500 Metal Fragments, 30 Rough Elunium and 100 Gold.^000000
We have it all except for the 50 Stones!
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
情况紧急！路障被摧毁了！
修复需要^3131FF50块石头、3个熊筋、500个金属碎片、30个铝原石和100个黄金。^000000
其他材料都齐了，就差50块石头！

scripts.text: Repair.
scripts.translation: 修复

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 暂不修复

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
You brought enough stones! Let's go and repair.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
你带够石头了！我们这就去修复。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
按适当的比例混合石头和黄金。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
按适当的比例混合石头和黄金，塑造成路障。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
按适当的比例混合石头和黄金，塑造成路障，再加入铝原石加固。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger. Now decorate with Metal Fragments.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
按适当的比例混合石头和黄金，塑造成路障，再加入铝原石加固。
接着用金属碎片装饰。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Combine Stones and Gold in the proper percentage and shape the Barricade, then add Rough Elunium to make it stronger. Decorate with Metal Fragments, and plait stones with Sinew of Bear!
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
按适当的比例混合石头和黄金，塑造成路障，再加入铝原石加固。
用金属碎片装饰，最后用熊筋把石头绑在一起！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
Wow! It's done.
We are relieved.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
哇！完成了。
这下能松口气了。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
You don't have enough Stones!
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
你的石头不够！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
^3131FFWe need 50 Stones.^000000
We are busy, so please hurry.
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
^3131FF我们需要50块石头。^000000
时间紧迫，请尽快！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
There are enemies coming! Let's evacuate from here!
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
敌人来了！快撤离这里！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Blacksmith]
There the enemy is coming!
scripts.translation:
[吉约姆铁匠]
看那边，敌人来了！

scripts.text:
[Battle Therapist]
Just close your eyes,
and take a deep breath.
You can be free from pain.
scripts.translation:
[战斗治疗师]
闭上眼睛，深呼吸。
疼痛很快就会消失。

scripts.text:
[Valley Ghost]
Boo...Boo...
scripts.translation:
[山谷幽灵]
呜...呜...

scripts.text:
Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
让我们共享胜利的荣光！
{0}，这是胜利的象征。

scripts.text:
[Axl Rose]
Blessed Guillaume!
Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克塞尔·罗斯]
吉约姆保佑！
让我们共享胜利的荣光！
{0}，这是胜利的象征。

scripts.text:
[Swandery]
Blessed Croix!
Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
[斯万德里]
克鲁瓦保佑！
让我们共享胜利的荣光！
{0}，这是胜利的象征。

scripts.text:
[Axl Rose]
You lost, but you're dedicated to this battle.
This is a reward for your great dedication by Guillaume Marollo!
Just take this defeat as a lesson, and next time you will definitely win.
scripts.translation:
[阿克塞尔·罗斯]
你输了，但仍为这场战斗全力以赴。
这是吉约姆·马洛洛为表彰你付出的努力而送上的奖励！
把这次失败当作教训，下次你一定会赢。

scripts.text:
[Swandery]
Oh, {0} Don't be sad.
Even though we didn't win, we did our best.
This is a Royal gift from Croix, and please don't forget this battle. We will win the next one.
scripts.translation:
[斯万德里]
哦，{0}，别难过。
虽然我们没赢，但已经尽力了。
这是克鲁瓦王室送给你的礼物，请别忘记这场战斗。下次我们一定会赢。
